# neon_snapshot (Resource)

Manages a Neon snapshot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "neon_project" "example" {
  name = "foo"
}

resource "neon_snapshot" "example" {
  project_id = neon_project.example.id
  branch_id  = neon_project.example.branch.id
  name       = "example-snapshot"
  expires_at = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_id` (String) The Neon branch ID to capture. Immutable after creation.
- `project_id` (String) The Neon project ID.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the snapshot expires. Omit to leave the current expiration unchanged; set to null in configuration to clear it.
- `lsn` (String) WAL position (LSN) at which to capture the snapshot, in Postgres LSN format.
- `name` (String) Human-readable label for the snapshot.
- `timestamp` (String) Point in time captured by the snapshot, in RFC 3339 format.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp at which the snapshot was created.
- `diff_size` (Number) Incremental Postgres storage size in bytes since the previous scheduled snapshot.
- `full_size` (Number) Full logical size of the snapshot in bytes at the time it was taken.
- `id` (String) Composite ID of the form <project_id>/<snapshot_id>.
- `manual` (Boolean) True if the snapshot was created manually rather than by a schedule.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Server-generated snapshot identifier.
- `source_branch_id` (String) Branch from which this snapshot was created.



## Import

A Neon Snapshot can be imported to the terraform state by its composite identifier that consists of
`ProjectID` and `SnapshotID` separated by a forward slash.

Import using the [import block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

For example:

```hcl
import {
  to = neon_snapshot.example
  id = "curly-poetry-30604233/snap-bitter-waterfall-b56bcnij"
}
```

Import using the command `terraform import`:

```commandline
terraform import neon_snapshot.example "curly-poetry-30604233/snap-bitter-waterfall-b56bcnij"
```
